LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASSES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What words do we use to describe the position of people or objects in relation to others?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify prepositions correctly in oral and written texts
2. use prepositions correctly in varied texts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASSES
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes for Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify prepositions correctly in oral and written texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use prepositions correctly in varied texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What words do we use to describe the position of people or objects in relation to others?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify prepositions correctly in oral and written texts
2. use prepositions correctly in varied texts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
